title: Payment
waiting: Waiting for payment. This screen updates by itself.

expired.title: Payment time ran out
expired.text: The hold was released and the bike is available to others again. Book again, it only takes a minute.

rub.title: Transfer in rubles
rub.equals: This is {vnd} at the locked rate
rub.steps: Open your bank's app, choose a transfer by phone number (SBP) and send the exact amount. Tap a row to copy it.
rub.note: Tap only after you've sent the money. An administrator checks it by hand, and we hold the bike for up to 6 hours.
rub.checkingText: Once an administrator sees the money, the booking confirms automatically and the bot will message you.
